title: Pinned benchmark assertions are insufficient for product-effectiveness claims
description: Audit of all ten pinned evaluators found a secret test without provider-call counts or real Git setup, a reject-only acceptance test, in-process rather than cross-process concurrency, and other partial assertions. Public contracts and TRX error classification improve honesty but do not repair coverage. Keep productClaimEligible false until evaluator replacement and good/bad calibration. See docs/evidence/benchmark-contract-audit-2026-09-03.md.
